text:
Bhai, main samajh sakta hoon ki aapko address change karwana kitna zaroori hai kyunki delivery kal hi hai aur order already transit mein hai. 

Lekin system mein directly delivery address change karne ka option mere paas nahi hai. Iske liye main aapko ek human agent se connect kar raha hoon jo courier partner se baat karke aapki madad kar sakein. 

Kripya line par bane rahein, main aapko transfer kar raha hoon.
